title: Ing anino keng gulut ning tronu
intro: Makatalakad ka kilub ding patyu ning metung a mayupayang minunang kayarian, nung nu ing metung a mayupayang pamuntuk pepasiag na ing sarili na bilang dios da ring sablang tau. King siping na niting pamuntuk makatalakad ya ing metung a tapat a talasuyu, a mipagkalub king pekamaragul a ambisyun ning kayarian. Kayabe-abe, magplanu la at magplanu, e la bisang makiramdam kareng babala ning metung a tubud a mitubud ban gabayan la. Malyari meng abalu nung ninu ya ining tapat a talasuyu?
clues: Menuknangan ku king metung a mayupayang kayarian a sasakupan na ning metung a mayupayang tau a sasabing dios ya karing sablang tau.
Migsilbi kung kapanaligan a ministru na niting pamuntuk, at tiparan ku ing balang ambisyun at utus da.
Inyang dinatang ya ing metung a tubud ning Allah king kekaming bansa a mamaus kekami king katutwan, aku at ing kanakung pamuntuk e kami bisang makiramdam.
Inutus da kanaku ing patau kung maragul a api at magsadia kung ladrilyu para king maragul a pangatalakad.
Buri na ning kakung manimuna ing mitalakad yang metung a matas a istruktura a miras king banua mismu.
King katataulian, aku ing pekapun ku, ding kekaming sundalus, at aku, mebaldug kami king kalalaman na ning dagat.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
